name: spc-case-digest-v5
title: 最高法案例整理与裁判规则提炼
author: 林沛阳
description: 按最高法案例八段规范（基本信息、裁判要点、基本案情、裁判结果、裁判理由、裁判规则提炼、法律法规、案例意义）生成可直接入库的案例整理稿：法条必须写出条文内容并核验现行有效、按三级来源取用，裁判规则只从裁判要点忠实提炼、不自由发挥，排版可直接复制进 Word。
boundaries: 见 SKILL.md 能力边界与「本 skill 不做什么」。
title_en: SPC Case Digest & Adjudication Rule Extraction
description_en: Generate case digests of Supreme People's Court cases in a mandatory eight-part structure, with full statute text verified as currently effective, adjudication rules distilled faithfully from the holding, and Word-ready formatting — ready for your case bank.
